rows.title: 24/7 Emergency
rows.text: A resuscitation bay, triage nurse and duty physician on site every hour of the year.

rows.title: Intensive Care
rows.text: 34 ICU beds across general, cardiac, neuro and neonatal units with one-to-one nursing.

rows.title: Modular Operating Theatres
rows.text: Four laminar-flow theatres, one kept free at all times for emergencies.

rows.title: Laboratory
rows.text: Pathology, microbiology and histopathology with same-day reporting on routine work.

rows.title: Radiology & Imaging
rows.text: Digital X-ray, ultrasound, colour Doppler and CT with consultant reporting.

rows.title: Blood Bank Link
rows.text: Licensed storage with a direct line to the district blood bank for rare groups.

rows.title: 24-Hour Pharmacy
rows.text: In-house pharmacy stocking every drug on the hospital formulary, day and night.

rows.title: Physiotherapy Unit
rows.text: A gym-equipped department running inpatient rounds and outpatient courses.

rows.title: Ambulance Fleet
rows.text: Six vehicles, two of them advanced life support with a paramedic on board.

rows.title: Accessible Throughout
rows.text: Ramps, lifts and accessible toilets on every floor of the building.

rows.title: Hospital Kitchen
rows.text: Therapeutic diets cooked on site — renal, cardiac, diabetic and post-surgical.

rows.title: Visitor Amenities
rows.text: Free Wi-Fi, a cafeteria, prayer room and an attendant lounge on the ground floor.
